Messages.Author: Vinícius BH
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I'd like to know whether is possible this combo: My OBE vampire plays
SM at superior on an untapped titled vampire; he is emptied with
Heidelberg Castle and hunts with Abactor. In the resulting blood hunt,
I use the votes of the vampire stolen to vote for burning him.

Is the control of the stolen vampire returned to his original
Methuselah after or before the blood hunt? I guess that the blood hunt
is called during the action, so I can choose his votes.

Vinícius.

Spirit Marionette
Type: Action
Requires: Obeah/Dominate
[dom] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
[obe] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed and tap a ready minion controlled by your
prey (even if the target of the bleed is changed).
[OBE] +1 stealth action. (D) Take control of a ready untapped minion
until the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey
unless he or she must hunt.

Abactor
Type: Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to
call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as
if he or she had committed diablerie).

Heidelberg Castle, Germany
Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.
Tap to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two
ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move
and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

The stolen minion must bleed your prey unless he or she must hunt.
It's a mandatory action which means you can't do any other actions
before that (except other mandatory actions, like hunting with empty
vampires etc).

> By the way, I've seen somewhere in a tournament final report (I

No. I guess you could steal a minion with OBF, empty one of your own
vampires with Heidelberg and then hunt with your empty vampre in order
to play Veil the Legions with the marionetted vampire.

But, I can steal one untapped vampire with 'for', use Nocturn Theater
on him to tap a minion controlled by my prey (as a bonus), and play
Force of Will with him. A lot of moving parts (mainly protecting the
Nocturn Theater), I admit it, but it can be done.

Nocturn Theater

Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.

During your untap phase, you may tap this card and a ready vampire you
control to tap a minion controlled by your prey. Any titled vampire
may burn this card as a (D) action.

Force of Will
Type: Action
Requires: Fortitude
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable by a tapped vampire.
[for] (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. After resolution, this vampire takes 2
unpreventable aggravated damage even if the action is blocked.
[FOR] As above, but with +2 bleed, and the acting vampire takes only 1
unpreventable aggravated damage.

Messages.Author: Vinícius BH
Messages.Body:


So, does the "bleed or hunt" clause on SM 'create' a mandatory action
for the marionetted minion?

Messages.Author: henrik
Messages.Body:


Yes. Your next action must be to bleed with that minion, unless he or
she must hunt. Some exceptions exists where the stolen minion can't
hunt or bleed due to other card texts, but in most cases you just get
to steal it, bleed with it and return it.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On 11 nov, 17:15, Vinícius BH <mak...@gmail.com> wrote:
> So, does the "bleed or hunt" clause on SM 'create' a mandatory action
> for the marionetted minion?

Sort of. More specifically, the use of the word "must" makes the
action mandatory (it's not mandatory because it's a bleed, it's
mandatory because the card says the minion **must** bleed).
